content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To plan a trip to tibet, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Book the final international flight into Lhasa (45 minutes)
Step 2. Obtain a Chinese tourist visa (2 weeks)
Step 3. Research reputable Tibetan travel agencies (4 hours)
Step 4. Buy a heavy-duty down parka (1 hour)
Step 5. Purchase high-altitude hiking boots (2 hours)
Step 6. Pack the main suitcase (3 hours)
Step 7. Buy a portable oxygen concentrator (30 minutes)
Step 8. Apply for the Tibet Travel Permit through an agency (4 weeks)
Step 9. Book a private local guide for the Everest Base Camp trek (2 hours)
Step 10. Reserve a seat on the Qinghai-Tibet railway (30 minutes)
Step 11. Purchase specialized thermal base layers (1 hour)
Step 12. Determine the best time of year for the visit (2 hours)
Step 13. Select specific monasteries to visit in Shigatse (3 hours)

Step 15. Finalize the day-by-day itinerary (5 hours)
Step 16. Purchase a high-quality camera lens (1 hour)
Step 17. Buy motion sickness medication for mountain roads (15 minutes)
Step 18. Break in the new hiking boots (1 week)
Step 19. Withdraw Chinese Yuan from a local bank (30 minutes)
Step 20. Renew passport (6 weeks)
Step 21. Consult a travel clinic for health advice (1 hour)
Step 22. Book a room at the St. Regis Lhasa (30 minutes)
Step 23. Pay the deposit for the private tour (15 minutes)
Step 24. Apply for the Alien's Travel Permit for restricted areas (1 week)
Step 25. Select a tour package that includes a driver (2 hours)
Step 26. Research Tibetan customs and etiquette (3 hours)
Step 27. Identify the specific cities to visit (2 hours)
Step 28. Visit an outdoor gear store for supplies (3 hours)

Step 37. List necessary vaccinations (1 hour)
Step 38. Confirm the hotel booking in Chengdu (20 minutes)

Step 55. Confirm the group size for the tour (30 minutes)
Step 56. Buy a universal power adapter (15 minutes)
Step 57. Research the weather in Lhasa for the specific dates (1 hour)
Step 58. Download a translation app for offline use (10 minutes)
Step 59. Buy a compact first aid kit (30 minutes)
Step 60. Book a domestic flight within China (1 hour)
Step 61. Create a packing checklist (1 hour)
Step 62. Scan and print copies of the Tibet Permit (30 minutes)
Step 63. Choose a reputable tour operator (3 hours)
Step 64. Apply for a Military Permit for sensitive border zones (2 weeks)
Step 65. Research local Tibetan tea houses (2 hours)
Step 66. Check the validity of the current visa (15 minutes)
Step 67. Buy a high-quality reusable water bottle (15 minutes)
Step 68. Buy a journal to document the trip (15 minutes)
Step 69. Arrange for a house sitter (2 hours)
Step 70. Notify the bank of international travel (15 minutes)
Step 71. Purchase Diamox at the pharmacy (20 minutes)
Step 72. Buy a pair of polarized sunglasses (30 minutes)
Step 73. Buy a dry bag for electronics (20 minutes)
Step 74. Buy a pair of trekking poles (45 minutes)
Step 75. Pack the carry-on bag (1 hour)
Step 76. Book the initial flight to China (1 hour)
Step 77. Read reviews of local restaurants (2 hours)
Step 78. Buy a portable UV water purifier (1 hour)
Step 79. Confirm the final pickup time at the airport (15 minutes)
Step 80. Request a leave of absence from work (15 minutes)
